sentences.en: The doctor was not at home.

sentences.ar: كان عند السكوير تريلوني، بالبيت الكبير.
sentences.en: He was with Squire Trelawney, at the big house.

sentences.ar: السكوير كان زلمة طويل وغني، وصوته عالي، وبيحب المغامرات.
sentences.en: The squire was a tall, rich man, with a loud voice, who loved adventures.

sentences.ar: لما دخلت، كانوا قاعدين جنب النار، وقدامهم أكل.
sentences.en: When I came in, they were sitting by the fire, with food before them.

sentences.ar: حكيت لهم كل إشي من الأول.
sentences.en: I told them everything from the beginning.
And I put the bundle on the table.
The doctor said: Flint?
Have you heard of him?
The squire said: heard of him?
He was the most dangerous pirate in the world!

sentences.ar: وكل واحد بيعرف إنه دفن كنز بمكان ما.
sentences.en: And everyone knows he buried a treasure somewhere.

sentences.ar: إذا هاي الأوراق بتقول وين، يا دكتور، أنا بجهز سفينة بكرا.
sentences.en: If these papers say where, doctor, I fit out a ship tomorrow.
The doctor said: let us open them first.
And he opened the bundle with his knife.
In it there was a notebook and a sealed paper.

sentences.ar: الدفتر كان حسابات: تواريخ ومبالغ وأسماء سفن.
sentences.en: The notebook was accounts: dates and sums and the names of ships.
And beside every sum, a small cross.

sentences.ar: قال الدكتور: كل صليب سفينة غرقوها، وكل مبلغ حصته.
sentences.en: The doctor said: every cross is a ship they sank, and every sum his share.
And then he opened the sealed paper.
It was a map of an island.

sentences.ar: الجزيرة طولها تسعة ميل، وفيها تلات تلال.
sentences.en: The island was nine miles long, with three hills.
And on it three crosses in red ink.
And beside one was written: the treasure here.
And under the map, directions in Flint's hand.

sentences.ar: قفز السكوير وقال: بكرا بروح على بريستول!
sentences.en: The squire jumped up and said: tomorrow I go to Bristol!

sentences.ar: بعشرة أيام بيكون عنا سفينة، وبعدها بنطلع كلنا.
sentences.en: In ten days we will have a ship, and then we all set out.

sentences.ar: إنت يا دكتور، وأنا، وجيم كولد للسفينة.
sentences.en: You, doctor, and I, and Jim as cabin boy.
The doctor said: I will go with you.
But on one condition.
You tell no one about the map.
Not a word.
The squire said: me?
I am a grave!
And the doctor laughed, because he knew him.
